youtube.description:
In 1912, Charles Dawson unveiled the 'missing link.' It stayed in textbooks for four decades. In 1953, new dating tests exposed it: a medieval human skull, an orangutan's jaw, and teeth filed and stained to look ancient.

📂 Case File #008: The Piltdown Man

Sources: Weiner, Oakley & Le Gros Clark (1953); De Groote et al. (2016); overview: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Piltdown_Man
